name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Strawnana
description: Get wrapped in the smooth, fruity bliss of Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Strawnana, a flavor-packed indica hybrid that blends sweet berry and creamy banana notes with a deeply relaxing high. This easy-to-use brush lets you enhance dabs, joints, blunts, or bowls with pure, high-potency live resin. With rich strawberry, ripe banana, and tropical cream flavors, Strawnana delivers a wave of euphoria, followed by a soothing body buzz that melts away stress. Ideal for relaxing, unwinding, or sparking creativity, this strain keeps you chill yet functional.
